text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its future risk and prospects, not by my average cost or how painful it would be to admit a mistake.","Selling Stock A at a gain felt satisfying, but I should not sell winners merely to lock in gains or keep losers merely to avoid realizing pain.","Because past price changes do not predict future ones, I should review my portfolio periodically and manage diversification and risk rather than react to short-term moves."]}
